policy: External services are linked for manual cross-checking unless an authorised API/feed or written permission is confirmed. Do not scrape, mirror, or redistribute third-party tracker data against its terms.

sources.name: CardWatch AU
sources.description: Australian Pokémon TCG stock, release and restock reference. CardWatch's current terms prohibit scraping, mirroring, bulk re-extraction and redistribution of its catalogue, pricing and stock data.
sources.nextStep: Use the public page as a manual cross-check. Do not ingest its data unless CardWatch provides written permission or an authorised integration.

sources.name: CardTracker.au Developer API
sources.description: Advertises market and deals APIs plus retailer-restock webhooks. API/webhook pricing varies by use case; no access credentials or approved schema are configured in this repository.
sources.nextStep: Request API documentation, pricing, allowed display/cache use and webhook payload examples. Build the adapter only after access and terms are confirmed.

sources.name: DexCompare AU
sources.description: Australian sealed Pokémon product price and availability comparison across multiple stores. No public API/feed permission has been verified for this project.
sources.nextStep: Compare selected catalogue products manually; ask the operator about an authorised data feed before automation.

sources.name: TCG Tracker AU
sources.description: Australian TCG restock alerts across major retailers. Useful as a second alert channel, but no supported integration endpoint has been verified.
sources.nextStep: Use as an independent comparison, not a source to copy in bulk. Ask the operator about an official integration if needed.

sources.name: BuyWisely
sources.description: Broad Australian price comparison and price-drop tracking. Coverage for specific Pokémon TCG products and stock status may vary.
sources.nextStep: Use for occasional price-history cross-checks; do not treat it as confirmed Pokémon stock.

sources.name: Drop Store Collectables
sources.description: Australian Pokémon TCG retailer with current sealed-product listings and release coverage. Product pages can be checked manually; no authorised stock feed or API has been confirmed.
sources.nextStep: Use product-specific pages for manual price and stock confirmation. Ask the retailer about a permitted feed before automated checks.

sources.name: Good Games TCG
sources.description: Australian trading-card retailer with a Pokémon TCG range and nationwide store presence. No authorised data feed or API has been confirmed.
sources.nextStep: Check exact product pages manually and verify shipping, stock and language before recording an offer. Request an approved feed before integration.

sources.name: Cherry Collectables
sources.description: Australian collectibles retailer with Pokémon products and sealed items. No authorised data feed or API has been confirmed.
sources.nextStep: Use the retailer site for manual product-specific checks; do not infer availability from category pages.

sources.name: Treasure Vault AU
sources.description: Australian specialist retailer focused on sealed Pokémon TCG products. No authorised data feed or API has been confirmed.
sources.nextStep: Confirm exact product, language, sealed condition, stock and shipping on the retailer's product page. Ask about an approved feed before automation.

sources.name: Aus Sealed Collectables
sources.description: Australian online store specialising in factory-sealed Pokémon TCG, including English and Japanese products. No authorised data feed or API has been confirmed.
sources.nextStep: Use individual product pages for manual confirmation and ask about a permitted feed before automated monitoring.
